chapter.verse: Zeisu lampi-ah a pai lai takin a nu’ sung pan mittaw khat a mu hi.
A nungzuite in, “Rabbi aw, kua mawhna hanga hihpa’ mittaw ahi hiam? Ama mawhna hang ahi hiam, a nu leh pa’ mawhna hang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Hih pa’ mawhna hang ahi zongin, a nu leh pa’ mawhna hang ahi zongin ahi kei hi. Pasian’ nasepna ama tungah a kilat theih nadingin mittaw-in a suak hi.
Ni a om lai teng kei hong sawlpa’ na i seem ding hi. Kuamah in na a sep theih loh hun zan hong tung ding hi.
Leitungah ka om lai tengin leitung’ khuavak ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin lei tungah a cil sia a, cil tawh buan a bawl khit ciangin mittawpa’ mit ah buan nuhsak a,

“Pai in la, Siloam bual tui sungah na mit na sil in,” ci-in a sawl hi. Siloam a khiatna in “Hong sawl hi” cihnopna hi. Tua ahih ciangin, tua pa pai-in a sil khit ciangin a mit in khua mu-in hong ciahkik hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in khutdawh ngen mi ahih lam a inn veengte leh amah a mu ngeite in, “Hih pa in tu-a khutdawh ngenpa hilo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Midangte in, “Ahi hi,” a ci uh hi. Kimkhat in, “Ahi kei hi, a kibang hi,” a ci uh hi. Amah in, “Kei tua pa ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amau in, “Tua ahih leh, na mittang bangci-a hong vak ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Amah in, “Zeisu kici mi khat in buan bawla ka mitah a nuh khit ciangin, ‘Siloam bualah pai in la, sil in,’ hong cih bangin pai-in ka sil leh, khua ka mu hi,” a ci hi.
Amau in, “Tua pa koi lai-ah om hiam?” ci-a a dot uh ciangin, “Ka thei kei hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in tua mittawpa Farisaite kiangah a paipih uh hi.
Zeisu in buan bawlin mit a vaksak ni in Sabbath ni ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khatvei Farisaite in zong, “Na mitang bangci a hong vak hiam?” ci-in a dong kik uh hi. Amah in, “Ka mitah buan hong nuh a, ka sil khit ciangin khua ka mu thei hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Farisaite kimkhat in, “Hih mi in Sabbath ni tang lo ahih ciangin Pasian sawl mi ahi kei hi,” a ci uh hi. Kimkhat in, “Mawhnei mi khat in hih bang nalamdang a lak thei ding hiam?” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute kithutuak loin a kikhenthang uh hi.
Tua ciangin khatvei amau in, “Na mit hong vaksakpa kua tawh kibang ahi hiam? Bangci na ngaisun hiam?” ci-in mittaw ngeipa a dong uh hi. Amah in, “Pasian’ kamsangpa ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite in mittaw khua mukikpa’ nu leh pa sam uh a, “Hih pa in a suahpih mittaw ahi na cih na tapa uh ahi hiam?
Tua ahih leh, bangci tu-in khua mu thei hiam?” ci-in a dot matengun amah in nidang lai mittawsa a nung ciangin khua mu kik cih a um kei uh hi.
A nu leh pate in, “Hih pa in komau tapa hi a, a suahpih mittaw ahih ka thei uh hi.

Ahih hangin tu-in bangci a khua mukik thei hiam ci-in ka thei kei uh hi. Kua in ama mit vaksak hiam ci-in ka thei kei uh hi. Amah khan’ cing zo hi; amah na dong un, amah in ama thu hong gen ding hi,” a ci uh hi.

A nu leh pate in Judah mite a kihtak manunah tua bangin a gen uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, “Zeisu in Khazih ahi hi a ci mi khempeuh biakna innpi pan kihawlkhia ding hi,” ci-in amaute in a vaihawm zo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in, “Amah a khan’ cing zo hi, amah na dong un,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, a mittaw ngeipa sam kik uh a, “Pasian phat in, hih mi in mawhnei mi ahih kote’n ka thei uh hi,” a cih uh ciangin,
amah in, “Mawhnei mi hiam hi lo hiam ka thei kei hi. Thu khat ka thei hi; nidangin mittaw ka hi a, tu-in khua ka mu thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, “Nangma tungah bang hong bawl ahi hiam? Na mittang bangci a hong vaksak hiam?” ci-in a dot kik uh leh,
amah in, “Keimah in khatvei kong gen khit hangin na ngai kei uh hi. Bang hangin za kik nuam na hi uh hiam? Ama nungzui suak nuam na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dawng kik hi.
Amaute in, “Nangmah in ama nungzui na hi hi. Ahih hangin kote ka hih uh leh, Moses’ nungzuite ka hi uh hi.
Pasian in Moses kiangah thu pia zo cih ka thei uh hi. Ahih hangin hih pa ahih leh, koi pan hong piang hiam ka thei kei uh hi,” ci-in a gensia uh hi.
Amah in, “Ka mittang hong vaksak hi napi-in a pian’na na theih loh uh lamdang hi.
Pasian in mawhneite’ thu ngai lo hi ci-in eite i thei hi. Pasian zahtaka ama deihna a zui mite thu Pasian in a ngai hi.
Lei piancil akipanin kuamah in suahpih mittaw khua a musak kik hi ci-in a kiza ngei kei hi.
Hih pa in Pasian kiang pan hong pai kei leh, bangmah a hih thei kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Nangmah in na suah akipan khialhna tawh kidim hi napi-in, kote thu hong hilh ding na hi hiam?” ci-in tua pa biakna innpi pan a hawlkhia uh hi.
Amaute in amah a hawlkhiatna thu Zeisu in za a, tua pa a muh ciangin, “Pasian’ Tapa na um hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amah in, “Topa aw, amah ka up nadingin Pasian’ Tapa kua ahi hiam?” ci-in a dawng kik hi.
Zeisu in, “Amah na mu zo tham loin nang tawh tu-in thu genpa in Pasian’ Tapa ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Topa aw, ka um hi,” ci-in amah a bia hi.
Zeisu in, “Khua mu thei lote a muh nading ahi zongin, khua mu theite in mittawt nading ahi zongin thu khen dingin leitungah kong pai hi,” a ci hi.
Ama kiangah a om Farisaite kimkhat in tua thu a zak uh ciangin, “Ko zong mittaw ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note mittaw na hih uh leh, mawhna na nei kei ding uh hi. Ahih hangin ‘Khua ka mu uh hi,’ ci na hih uh ciangin na mawhna uh a om lai hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
